notes: className -> engine family, derived from the shipped sheets (pkg_2115 ZombieType, pkg_2112 ZombieProperties, pkg_2111 ZombieActions).
A class is judged by at least half of its own types, because ZombieClass is a shared base (ZombieBasic owns 240 types, a few of which carry spawn actions).

steal has no ZombieActions verb in this build; it is detected from the ..._BUNGEE animation. ZombieLostCityRelicHunter is the only class that reaches it (2 of its 3 types are bungees), so the ordinary relic-hunter type shares that base class.
generated is a fixed marker, not a timestamp, so two runs are byte-identical.
13 classes carry a human override; every one is marked in its note.
